title: 대심판선 아래의 피난 항로
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. A NEW AsteraCraft cinematic loading painting rendered as convincing live-action aircraft photography, landscape16:9, no words/UI.
Authoritative geometry: IMAGE1 contains FOUR DIRECTIONS OF THE SAME ACTUAL CAPITAL SHIP. Use them together to understand its true structure; do not copy the technical sprite camera.
This is a flat HORIZONTAL ivory-and-gold ring-shaped vessel, red luminous INNER RING channel, with ONE TALL NARROW UPRIGHT TAPERED IVORY MECHANICAL PYLON anchored EXACTLY AT THE CENTER OF THE RING. The pylon has the pointed gold-edged tip, slightly conical/triangular faceted base, dark inset panels and small red central details seen in all four source views. Its height is roughly half the ring's diameter, its base width about one quarter of the diameter. It stands VERTICALLY UP from the middle like the actual reference, clearly DISTINCT from the nose.
A SMALL OWL-BEAK PROW with TWO red side eyes is attached ONLY to the FRONT OUTER RIM, as seen in source views1/2/3/4. Keep this forward owl head SMALL (about one sixth of ring diameter), not an enormous long bird face. It must not become an elongated spine across the opening. The central upright pylon and the small front rim prow are separate original features. Leave the two original curved open gaps between pylon base and ring. The ring stays almost horizontal, not an upright wheel, tilted torus arch or flying gate. No long diagonal bridge through the hole, no castle, buildings, dome, city or added turret.
Story: after crossing a turbulent cloud bank, the great capital ship shelters ONE actual damaged owl transport in the calmer air alongside and BELOW its forward rim, guiding it into a patch of warm sunlight. Transport matches IMAGE2: compact low ivory hull, gold beak nose and FOUR red round corner engine pods, one existing pod with a little soot. No other units, no firing, no explosions.
CAMERA: realistic aerial front three-quarter view from slightly ABOVE THE RING PLANE but BELOW THE PYLON TIP, looking across the vessel at about 12 degrees downward, a cinematic near-eye-level view with a distant level cloud HORIZON. Show the ring as a broad FLAT ELLIPSE in perspective, roughly 3 times wider than its projected height. The central mechanical pylon rises upright from its true middle and is completely visible; small owl nose sits at near/front-right rim. Transport is just one-sixth as wide as the capital and not pasted into the foreground. Keep the great ship imposing and full-size with believable physical proportions.
STYLE: image3 is only a material/lighting benchmark for tactile matte ivory, tarnished gold, deep red accents, warm natural rays and realistic atmospheric depth, not its characters or setting. Fine ceramic/metal scuffs, subtle restrained red inner-ring glow, weighty smooth hull panels, sunlight and cloud reflections unified on both aircraft. No toy gloss, miniature diorama blur, game screenshot, overhead isometric sprite view or unrelated anatomy. The central upright pylon must be the actual existing design from the four reference views, not an invented architecture.
